# ymfm reference

Source: https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm
Revision: `81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a`
Author: Aaron Giles. License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE).

The nine source/header files are unmodified. DiscoFM's C++14 wrapper is
`../../native/ymfm_reference.cpp`. This independent, sample-level renderer is
used for comparisons and optional fitting-proposal screening. Nuked-OPN2 remains
the production synthesis backend and supplies every retained fitting score.
